evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications.
